items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'Ralph was talking to the waitress...'

ctx.x: Yeah that was before the war, that was before the war. Everything was really, you know what I mean, cheap then. Yeah. Yeah that was, you see that was after the first war, you see, after the first war, you see.

Speaking of the good luck business and charms and all that, Ralph was talking to the waitress, you know his friend, the woman, you know, the white woman over at the waitress at the Moulin Rouge, when there weren't very good crowds there, you know a couple months ago when you were there, and she was saying she could get that fixed somewhere too, if she'd go down and see somebody, cost some money. Is there much of that, there's more of that going on, is that the real hoodoo or what would you say that is?
